H4609: elevation, i.e. the act (literally, a journey to a higher place, figuratively, a thought arising), or (concretely) the condition (literally, a step or grademark, figuratively, a superiority of station); specifically a climactic progression (in certain Psalms)
H518: used very widely as demonstrative, lo!; interrogative, whether?; or conditional, if, although; also Oh that!, when; hence, as a negative, not
H3068: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
H3808: not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
H1004: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
H7723: evil (as destructive), literally (ruin) or morally (especially guile); figuratively idolatry (as false, subjective), uselessness (as deceptive, objective; also adverbially, in vain)
H5998: to toil, i.e. work severely and with irksomeness
H8104: properly, to hedge about (as with thorns), i.e. guard; generally, to protect, attend to, etc.
H5892: a city (a place guarded by waking or a watch) in the widest sense (even of a mere encampment or post)
H8245: to be alert, i.e. sleepless; hence to be on the lookout (whether for good or ill)
H7925: literally, to load up (on the back of man or beast), i.e. to start early in the morning
H6965: to rise (in various applications, literal, figurative, intensive and causative)
H309: to loiter (i.e. be behind); by implication to procrastinate
H3427: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
H3899: food (for man or beast), especially bread, or grain (for making it)
H6089: an earthen vessel; usually (painful) toil; also a pang (whether of body or mind)
H3651: properly, set upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) just; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles)
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H5159: properly, something inherited, i.e. (abstractly) occupancy, or (concretely) an heirloom; generally an estate, patrimony or portion
H1121: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
H7939: payment of contract; concretely, salary, fare, maintenance; by implication, compensation, benefit
H990: the belly, especially the womb; also the bosom or body of anything
H2671: properly, a piercer, i.e. an arrow; by implication, a wound; figuratively, (of God) thunderbolt; the shaft of aspear
H3027: a hand (the open one (indicating power, means, direction, etc.),
H5271: (only in plural collectively or emphatic form) youth, the state (juvenility) or the persons (young people)
H835: happiness; only in masculine plural construction as interjection, how happy!
H1397: properly, a valiant man or warrior; generally, a person simply
H834: who, which, what, that; also (as an adverb and a conjunction) when, where, how, because, in order that, etc.
H4390: to fill or (intransitively) be full of, in a wide application (literally and figuratively)
H853: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
H954: properly, to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed; also (by implication) to be disappointed or delayed
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H1696: perhaps properly, to arrange; but used figuratively (of words), to speak; rarely (in a destructive sense) to subdue
H854: properly, nearness (used only as a preposition or an adverb), near; hence, generally, with, by, at, among, etc.
H8179: an opening, i.e. door or gate
